name: fremi-framework
description: Product Discovery + SDD + BDD + TDD framework CLI for AI coding agents (Claude Code by now).
author: fhidalgoGC

scripts.build:all: bun run build:darwin-arm64 && bun run build:darwin-x64 && bun run build:linux-x64 && bun run build:linux-arm64 && bun run build:windows-x64
scripts.sandbox:reset: rm -rf sandbox && mkdir sandbox && echo 'Fresh sandbox at ./sandbox — run `bun run sandbox:install` to install fremi there'
scripts.sandbox:tree: find sandbox -type f -o -type l 2>/dev/null | sort | head -50
scripts.sandbox:cycle: bun run sandbox:reset && bun run sandbox:install && bun run sandbox:tree
scripts.release:publish: bun run build:all && gh release create v$(cat VERSION) bin/fremi-* --repo fhidalgoGC/homebrew-tap --title "v$(cat VERSION)" --generate-notes
